Key points
• Vitamin E is a potent fat-soluble antioxidant
• Vitamin E functions to stop lipid peroxidation
• Vitamin E deﬁciency occurs in humans with gene defects in the a-tocopherol transfer protein (a-TTP) or with fat malab-
sorption syndromes
• a-TTP and vitamin E catabolism function to maintain the body’s preference for a-tocopherol
